electronics_review_filter:
SELECT p.ref_id, p.price, COUNT(r.rating) AS review_count, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_review_rating
FROM products p
JOIN reviews r ON p.category = r.category AND p.ref_id = r.ref_id
WHERE p.category = 'electronics' AND p.price > 50
GROUP BY p.ref_id, p.price
HAVING COUNT(r.rating) >= 5 AND AVG(r.rating) < 3.0
